test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cda4522382c04f722ebd7c75e8145960ba2cf751914f78a4ae6cd5e80d743976.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

1) YJB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d912619fc35350d2db28f10673dce1967b1b21f4dab228602275121a09dac88.png] 

**Y(25) + 11 = 36 = 26 + 10 = J(10) **

**J - 8 = B**

2) UFQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78654b27a605eed5bfa7bb50a153f87b15c5658fc22dc36a09adec111e772041.png] 

U(21) + 11 = 32 = 26 + 6 = F(6) 

F** + 11 **= Q

3) RCN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/929e418115b5da23a5087658d5e53866222c5a076c3fc49b231e180852367ab9.png] 

R(18) + 11 = 29 = 26 + 3 = C(3)

C **+ 11** = N

4) EPA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9e56e658b18929712d2baa9695a24da90b00842159399cbbc676b623e240440.png] 

P + 11 = 27 = **(26 + 1) = A**

∴ Here, 'YJB' is different from the other three alternatives.

Hence, the correct answer is **"YJB".**
